note: First-floor 'times of life' room. Feminine nouns on the left and centre (la fin, l'époque, l'enfance, la génération, l'existence, la naissance, la retraite, la période); masculine on the right (le début, le départ, le passé, l'avenir, le destin, le sort). Eight feminine words, so the divider is offset to x=780. The wooden door on the far left goes back to the second adverbs room; the staircase on the right goes UP to the attic adverbs room.
